text:
sre-bot: ALERT hosted-usw2-gpu-pool p95 queueing > 12s for 15m :fire:  
Details: https://dash.redwood/internal/hosted-usw2/pools/hosted-gpu-3 -> admission rate nearing capacity, evictions increasing

alex: saw it, thanks. traffic spike from batch jobs + a few big embeddings RL jobs.

maria: looking at per-route breakdown now — a handful of customers account for ~40% of new admissions. low-priority reroutes might buy us time.

kevin: can we short-circuit warmup containers? warmups are taking slots and not serving real traffic.

jin: autoscaler tried to request more nodes but hit cloud quota; saw an error in scaler logs: `QuotaExceeded: gpu-cores` around 2149998987.

alex: ok quick plan: 1) throttle admission for non-SLA routes 2) disable warmup pods in hosted-usw2 3) overflow low-priority to dedicated pools 4) manual emergency scale if quota freed

maria: I can push the admission rule change — reducing per-customer rate to 60% for tier:free and tier:trial. Applying in 30s.

kevin: i'll disable warmup job cron and evict warmups now (`kubectl -n warmups delete pod -l warmup=true --field-selector=status.phase=Running`).

jin: filing a cloud quota escal ticket and pinging infra-ops to see if we can borrow GPUs from euw1 for 10-20 minutes. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/inc/9876

sre-bot: action taken: admission-policy updated by maria at 2149999012, warmup eviction triggered by kevin at 2149999020.

maria: admission policy reduced inbound rate for tier:free/trial. watching p95.

alex: temporary routing rule to send `noncritical-embedding` to dedicated-usw2 created. Note: expect ~200ms extra latency.

kevin: warmups freed ~6 nodes, pods are rescheduling. p95 dropped to 7.8s in the last 3m. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

jin: cloud quota still pending but we've bought ~10m headroom. I'll keep pushing for quota bump.

alex: good work — i'll update the incident log and set a follow-up to revert admission throttles when p95 < 3s for 15m.

maria: follow-up: add rule to exclude pinned enterprise routes from throttles next time, to avoid impacting paying customers.

kevin: note for postmortem: warmup jobs shouldn't allocate full GPU resources; propose a shared warmup pool or reduced resources for warmups.

alex: agreed. short postmortem notes added. closing this thread if p95 stays down.

sre-bot: RESOLVED hosted-usw2 p95 queueing back under threshold at 2149999055.
